self_summary: The runnable SDK shelf: one page per capability, every fence pinned by a test. Connections, credentials, data sources, datasets, activity, agents on email, chat and help-desk channels, channel webhook routing, message threads, stream inbox automations, LLM endpoints, processes, workflows, compute ops, wizards, decisions, RAG, project and asset dependencies and the one call-return contract.
